lines.zh: 盾牌挡在身前，我一步步压过去。
lines.en: Shield forward, I press on step by step.

lines.zh: 我穿着捡来的靴子，踩得很稳。
lines.en: These scavenged boots keep my footing sure.
The helmet is a size small, but it holds.

lines.zh: 我走在同伴前面，这是本分。
lines.en: I walk ahead of my kin; that is my duty.

lines.zh: 甲片碰在一起，叮当作响。
lines.en: My plates knock together, ringing.
I hug the wall to guard my flank.

lines.zh: 十二点护甲，压得我步子很沉。
lines.en: Twelve points of armor keeps my steps heavy.

lines.zh: 谁在我背后，我听得出来。
lines.en: I can hear who walks behind me.
I raise the shield to cover my chin.
Blood ahead. I slow down.

lines.zh: 靴底磨平了，还得再找一双。
lines.en: My soles are worn through. I need another pair.

lines.zh: 我不追，我等你自己过来。
lines.en: I do not chase. I wait for you to come.

lines.zh: 我把盾立在脚边，擦了擦。
lines.en: I set the shield down and wipe it.

lines.zh: 头盔里还留着别人的汗味。
lines.en: Someone else's sweat still fills this helmet.

lines.zh: 我检查每一条甲片的缝。
lines.en: I check the seam of every plate.
My kin sleep. I keep watch.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在头盔里回响。
lines.en: My breath echoes inside the helmet.
I was an adventurer once.

lines.zh: 那只末影珍珠，我留到最后用。
lines.en: That ender pearl I save for last.

lines.zh: 盾面上的凹痕，每道都是故事。
lines.en: Every dent in this shield tells a story.
I count my kin, and the count is small.

lines.zh: 没有敌情时，我反而更紧张。
lines.en: With no enemy near, I tense up more.
I retie the laces of my boots.

lines.zh: 菌丝从甲缝里钻出来，我掐掉。
lines.en: Mycelium creeps from my plates; I pinch it off.

lines.zh: 我在想退路，不在想进攻。
lines.en: I think of retreat lines, not attacks.
Standing this long makes my knees click.
I flip the shield over to check its back.

lines.zh: 远处的嘶叫，我数了三声。
lines.en: Three shrieks in the distance. I count them.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，让腿歇一会儿。
lines.en: I crouch to let my legs rest.

lines.zh: 菌丝在骨头上结了一层。
lines.en: Mycelium has crusted over the bone.
That stance says you came to fight.

lines.zh: 我在看你的手，不是眼睛。
lines.en: It is your hands I watch, never your eyes.

lines.zh: 你的盾压得太低，露出锁骨。
lines.en: Your shield hangs low; your collarbone shows.

lines.zh: 站远一点，我盾击有点重。
lines.en: Stand back; my shield bash is heavy.
You carry no scent of mycelium.
I am pacing your distance. Eight steps.

lines.zh: 你若是同伴，就放下武器。
lines.en: If you are kin, lower that weapon.
Do not touch the ones behind me.

lines.zh: 这种眼神，我在营地里见过。
lines.en: I have seen that look back at the camp.
If you strike, come at me head on.
Do not circle; I defend well.
Your armor is lighter than mine.
You caught me from the side.
My shield did not take that one.
Even twelve points of plates can crack.
I fall back half a step and raise my shield.
It stings, but I will not break formation.
That blade got in at my boot top.
My helmet has a new dent.
You are aiming at an old wound.
Fifty points. I can still stand.
Teeth clenched, I push the shield back out.
Food? What I lack is a bracer.

lines.zh: 你拿肉引我，我不会离开岗位。
lines.en: Meat will not draw me from my post.
Put it on the ground and back away.

lines.zh: 陌生人给的东西，先让同伴尝。
lines.en: Let my kin taste what strangers offer first.
Those iron boots. Would you give them?

lines.zh: 我只在饿得站不住时吃一口。
lines.en: I eat only when hunger drops me.

lines.zh: 你把食物放在石头上就好。
lines.en: Leave the food on the stone. That is all.
I will smell it before I decide.

lines.zh: 有吃的，同伴就能多撑一天。
lines.en: With food, my kin last one more day.
I will remember this kindness of yours.

lines.zh: 你撞在盾上，自己反弹了吧。
lines.en: You ran into my shield and bounced, did you not?
I stand too firmly to be moved.
Back off; do not crowd my line.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把你推出去两步。
lines.en: That bump pushed you back two steps.

lines.zh: 我的甲很硬，你的肩膀呢。
lines.en: My plates are hard. How is your shoulder?

lines.zh: 别从侧面挤，我护不到那里。
lines.en: Do not press from the side; I cannot guard it.
You stepped on my boot.

lines.zh: 撞得盾都歪了，我扶正它。
lines.en: We hit so hard my shield skewed. I straighten it.
I turn aside, still blocking the way.
Do not push; my shield pushes back.
Would you stand behind me?

lines.zh: 我需要一个能守后背的人。
lines.en: I need someone to guard my back.

lines.zh: 我们把盾并在一起，试试。
lines.en: Let us set our shields side by side.
I block for you; you watch for me.

lines.zh: 这头盔，我分你一只靴子。
lines.en: For this helmet, I would trade you a boot.

lines.zh: 我不会说好听的，只会挡刀。
lines.en: I have no sweet words, only a shield.

lines.zh: 两个守夜的人，夜就短了。
lines.en: Two watchers make the night shorter.

lines.zh: 你受伤时，我会先冲过去。
lines.en: When you are hurt, I charge in first.
We give each other our backs.

lines.zh: 你也是被菌丝改造的吗。
lines.en: Were you remade by the mycelium too?
I pick up a shard of shield.

lines.zh: 这只靴子是左脚的，正好。
lines.en: This boot is for the left foot. Perfect.
A cracked helmet lies on the ground.
I pull the broken arrow out and keep it.
This iron can patch my shield.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时，盾一直朝着前面。
lines.en: As I bend, my shield stays forward.
A dropped bracer. That is mine.
I weigh a stone in my palm.
This plate has years left in it.
I leave the coins. They are useless.
You struck one of mine.
I saw that wound land.
Locking onto you is for them.

lines.zh: 你退到掩体后面也没用。
lines.en: Hiding behind cover will not help you.

lines.zh: 我要先解决拿远程的那个。
lines.en: I deal with the ranged one first.
You walked across our spore mat.
Target chosen; my shield is up.
I see your partner waiting for you.
This time I will not only defend.

lines.zh: 你离得太近了，退不掉了。
lines.en: You are too close to retreat now.

lines.zh: 我举盾，一步步缩短距离。
lines.en: Shield raised, I close the distance slowly.
Where you swing, I block.
The ender pearl in my hand is cold.

lines.zh: 我的脚步跟着你的重心走。
lines.en: My steps follow your center of weight.

lines.zh: 你抬手就是要打，我看得出。
lines.en: A raised hand means a blow. I can tell.
Do not think flanking will work.

lines.zh: 我先不动，等你露出空档。
lines.en: I hold still and wait for an opening.
My shield rim lines up with your throat.

lines.zh: 你呼吸乱了，时机快到了。
lines.en: Your breathing broke rhythm. The moment nears.
Three, two, one. I advance.
My shield rim meets your jaw.
Eight points, straight on.

lines.zh: 盾一送，你整个人往后滑。
lines.en: One shield shove slides you backwards.

lines.zh: 你砍在盾上，虎口发麻吧。
lines.en: You struck the shield. Your hands must sting.
This one is repayment for my kin.

lines.zh: 我压上去，不给你退的空。
lines.en: I press in, leaving you no room.
A shield bash is duller than a blade.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在我这里不算什么。
lines.en: Your armor means little to me.
I strike your knee to drop you.
One hit and you should fall back.

lines.zh: 我从菌染里站起来，先找盾。
lines.en: I rise from the infection and look for a shield.
The helmet is scavenged. So are the boots.

lines.zh: 我记得自己是个冒险家。
lines.en: I remember being an adventurer.

lines.zh: 谁在附近，我要先护住自己。
lines.en: Whoever is near, I guard myself first.

lines.zh: 甲片还在，身体却换了主人。
lines.en: The plates remain; the body changed hands.

lines.zh: 我第一件事是把盾立好。
lines.en: My first act is to set the shield.

lines.zh: 菌丝说，要守着一片地方。
lines.en: The mycelium says: guard this ground.
I straighten and take two test steps.

lines.zh: 这副身体比我记得的更壮。
lines.en: This body is stronger than I recall.
Someone comes; I block the path.
I slide my old sword back into place.

lines.zh: 从今往后，我只后退一步。
lines.en: From now on, I retreat only one step.
Fire crawls in through my plate seams.

lines.zh: 落地时盾先着地，砸弯了。
lines.en: My shield hit first and bent on landing.

lines.zh: 头盔进水，我什么都看不见。
lines.en: Water fills my helmet; I see nothing.

lines.zh: 爆炸震得我耳朵一直响。
lines.en: The blast left a ringing I cannot shake.
An arrow sticks in my plate like a thorn.
The potion went around my shield and burned.
Empty, I can no longer lift my shield.

lines.zh: 雷穿过甲片，手臂全麻了。
lines.en: Lightning crossed my plates and numbed my arm.

lines.zh: 我举着盾往下坠，毫无用处。
lines.en: Shield raised, I fall, and it is useless.
